summary: Ondas Inc. filed an 8-K announcing a prospectus supplement for the resale of 6,070,948 shares of common stock by certain stockholders. The shares were previously issued in two acquisitions: 3,019,066 shares in the acquisition of Omnisys Ltd. (May 21, 2026) and 3,051,882 shares in the acquisition of Indo Earth Moving Ltd. (March 17, 2026). The resale is covered under an existing S-3ASR shelf registration. No new capital raise or special situation event is triggered; this is a routine resale registration. No deal terms, prices, or advisory roles are stated. This is a procedural filing for secondary sales.
